title: Hawaasa Guyyaa Boqonnaa Morme
intro: Qubsuma qarqara galaanaa bakka ajajni waaqaa guyyaa tokko waaqeffannaa fi of qabuuf adda baafame keessa tarkaanfadhu. Gareen hawaasa kana keessa jiru tokko karoora haxxummaadhaan daangaa ajaja sanaa qorachuu filate, kunis jijjiirama baroota keessatti sagalee ta’u fide. Lubbuuwwan kun eenyu turan, maal ta’e?
clues: Naannoo qarqara galaanaa, bakka galaanni jireenya keenya nuuf argamsiisutti jiraanna turre.
Torban keessaa guyyaa tokko akka kabajnu, hojii addunyaa irraa adda baafnee akka kabajnu ajajamne.
Guyyaa sana qurxummiin akka waan ajaja cabsuuf nu qorutti baay’inaan nutti dhufe.
Jala bultii guyyaa qulqulluu sanaa qurxummii sana kiyyootti galchuuf, achiis erga darbee booda walitti qabuuf karoora baasne.
Gariin keenya gowwoomsaa kana yommuu akeekkachiisan gorsa isaanii tuffannee itti fufne.
Irra daddarba keenyaaf gara hantuutaatti jijjiiramne, tuffatamnee fi gatamne.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
